{"classification":"real_incident","summary":"GET /api/orders/express-1002 returns 500 (ValueError: day is out of range for month). order_detail() computes the express delivery estimate with placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2), which fails when the order date is within 2 days of month end. The seeded order express-1002 is dated the last day of the previous month (Aug 31 here, so day 33).","user_impact":"Every detail lookup of an express order created on the 30th or 31st, or on Feb 27-28 and so on, returns HTTP 500. In the evidence that is express-1002, with about 12 500s in 15 minutes. Standard orders and the 200 responses are unaffected.","root_cause":"app/main.py:81 uses date.replace(day=day+2) for the delivery estimate instead of date arithmetic. It raises ValueError for any express order whose created_at day is greater than (days in month - 2). The seed data (init_db) deliberately creates express-1002 at the previous month end, which triggers it.","evidence":[{"source":"logs","reference":"Loki error logs, trace b3141cbefdc4a6c76956dc4ad7f9b79f","observation":"19 ERROR lines on the route, all ValueError: day is out of range for month; stack ends at main.py:81 in order_detail."},{"source":"traces","reference":"Tempo trace 220cc9ab9c479bfc0547d8048476458b","observation":"The span orders.build_detail errors with order.priority=express; order.id=express-1002 on the root span; the db select succeeded."},{"source":"metrics","reference":"five_xx_last_5m / cumulative_by_status","observation":"All 5xx are error_type=ValueError on version 3982ab3; 12.6 500s vs 1.0 200s over 15m."},{"source":"code","reference":"app/main.py:81 and 61","observation":"placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2); the seed sets express-1002 created_at to the previous month end."},{"source":"code","reference":"tests/test_api.py::test_express_estimate_crosses_month_end","observation":"New regression test with a fixed date (2026-08-31) expects 2026-09-02; full suite passes, 6 passed."}],"confidence":0.96,"proposed_action":"patch","changes":[{"file":"app/main.py","description":"order_detail: estimated_at = placed_at + timedelta(days=2) instead of replace(day=day+2); timedelta was already imported."},{"file":"tests/test_api.py","description":"Added test_express_estimate_crosses_month_end, which uses a fixed 2026-08-31 date so it does not depend on today's date. It calls order_detail directly."}],"tests":{"ran":true,"command":"uv run --frozen pytest -q","passed":true,"summary":"6 passed with the fix. I did not run the new test against the unfixed code: the sandbox blocked the revert command. By inspection it fails, because day 31 + 2 = 33 raises ValueError."},"verification_requests":["/api/orders/express-1002"],"escalation_reason":null,"final_message":"INC-20260930-130646-e094: GET /api/orders/express-1002 returns 500 (ValueError: day is out of range for month).
Cause: app/main.py:81 computes the delivery estimate with replace(day=day+2), which breaks near month end. The seeded express-1002 is dated Aug 31.
Fix: use placed_at + timedelta(days=2), plus a regression test with a fixed date. Full suite passes (6 tests).
Verdict: real incident, one-line patch proposed, please deploy and replay /api/orders/express-1002."}
